children: BRP Inc., the maker of Sea-Doo and Ski-Doo, now expects a C$200 million ($145 million) net impact from US tariffs on products it exports to the US for the fiscal year, far less than initially anticipated, according to Bloomberg.
The reduced tariff hit allowed the Canadian recreational manufacturer to increase its financial outlook.

title: BRP Raises Outlook as Tariff Hit Shrinks to C$200 Million
